title: Building a synthetic marker scene
description: You can distinguish generated pixels from supplied marker coordinates.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You create a coordinate grid with the supplied dimensions and generate a gradient with random noise. Three stacked channels give the scene a tint, and clip bounds their values between zero and one.
marker_corners contains four explicit coordinate pairs. The comment orders them around the marker from top-left to bottom-left.

steps.question: Does this block run an image detector to obtain those corners?
steps.answer: No. It draws a polygon from the coordinate array supplied above.

steps.description: You display the generated scene and add an unfilled red polygon. show requests that figure; the supplied recording has no text output or rendered image.
